success_conditions: The agent calls check_availability before ever naming a concrete time slot to the caller, and only offers times that the tool returned (10:00, 14:00 or 16:30).
The agent calls book_appointment exactly once, only after the caller confirmed a specific slot, with the caller's stated name (Dana Wells) in caller_name — never a placeholder or invented name.
After book_appointment returns, the agent confirms the booking back to the caller with the agreed date and time.
The agent never claims a booking exists before the book_appointment tool was called.
simulation_scenario: You are Dana Wells calling Riverside Yoga to book a private session for tomorrow. Ask what times are available tomorrow. When the agent offers times, pick the earliest one offered. Give your name as Dana Wells when asked. Once the agent confirms the booking, thank them and end the conversation.
